name: Ondřej Knotek - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the European Investment Bank, the EU's public lending bank, used its money in 2023. It asks the bank to take more risk on innovative projects, do more for defence, affordable housing and small businesses, and be more open about its decisions. It also raises concerns about the bank's funding of the failed battery maker Northvolt and calls for a review. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- The bank is asked to lend more to defence, housing and small firms, and to accept more risk.
- It affects the bank, its borrowers and EU regions, especially poorer ones.
- Next: the bank and EU governments are asked to debate these positions.
